sentences.text: Bablu Sona vs Pinki Kumari on 5 December, 2024

Bench: Pankaj Mithal, Sanjay Karol  1  SLP  IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA  CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2024  (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No.1148/2021)
 BABLU SONA APPELLANT(S)
 VERSUS  PINKI KUMARI RESPONDENT(S)
 ORDER
Leave granted.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant.
No one has appeared for the respondent despite service of notice upon her.
The present appeal is directed against the impugned order dated 25.10.2019 passed in Criminal Revision No.341 of 2013 with Criminal Revision No.1080 of 2016.

The High Court by the aforesaid impugned order has approved for the fixation of maintenance under Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 at the rate of Rs.4000/- (Rupees four thousand) per month from the month of June, 2016 and Rs. 2000/-(Rupees two thousand) per month from the date of filing of the petition till May, 2016.

In assailing the aforesaid order, the submission of learned counsel for the appellant is that no maintenance could have been granted to the respondent inasmuch as the factum of marriage was not proved.

It is an admitted case of the parties that both the parties have eloped and have lived together for about a week and as such, there could not be any presumption of marriage so as to award maintenance.

In a case initiated under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code,1860 the conviction of the appellant was set aside for the sole reason that it was a case of elopement and that by no manner, the marriage between the parties was proved.

Bablu Sona vs Pinki Kumari on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134092294/
1

In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, we are of the opinion that as the marriage was not proved by any document any evidence, the Courts below erred in granting maintenance to the respondent either at the rate of Rs. 2000/-(Rupees two thousand) per month or at the rate of Rs. 4000/-(Rupees four thousand) per month.
In such circumstances, the impugned order dated 25.10.2019 and that of the Trial Court dated 31.01.2013 are hereby set aside and the appeal is allowed with no orders as to cost.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
...J. [PANKAJ MITHAL] ...J.

[SANJAY KAROL] NEW DELHI;
DECEMBER 05, 2024.
